d: Sal 2020 ke bihar vidhanasbha chunav ke dauran mahagathbandhan se siem pad ke davedar tejasvi yadav ne kaha tha ki agar vo satta men aae to pahli kaibinet baithak men das lakh sarkari naukriyon ki manzuri di jaegi.tatkalin endie aur pradesh ke mukhyamantri nitish kumar ne is vade ko tab asanbhav aur jhutha sapna bataya tha.aise men bibisi ne bihar ki rajdhani patna ke alag-alag ilaqon men rahne vale chhatron se bat ki aur ye janne aur samajhne ki koshish ki ki jitni aasani se rajnitik partiyan sarkari naukri dene ka dava karti hain, kya un naukriyon tak pahunchne ka safar utna hi aasan…
